warmup.description: Gently open joints and connect breath to movement to prepare for mobility-focused flow.
movements: Deep diaphragmatic breathing x 5 slow breaths
Neck mobility (gentle circles) x 5 each direction

main_exercises.name: Spine Wave Flow
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight only, move slowly through full spinal range
main_exercises.form_cue: Initiate movement from the pelvis and ripple through the spine

main_exercises.name: Hip Mobility Sequence
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight only, focus on smooth joint articulation
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep pelvis stable while moving the hip through controlled circles

main_exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation Flow
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight only, prioritize rotation over speed
main_exercises.form_cue: Rotate from the mid-back, not the lower back

main_exercises.name: Shoulder Mobility Sequence
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging during movement

cooldown.description: Deepen mobility gains and calm the nervous system with longer, passive stretches.
movements: Thread the needle x 30s each side

phase_notes.menstrual: This mobility-focused session is ideal—move gently and use breath to guide range of motion without forcing depth. It can help reduce stiffness and discomfort.
phase_notes.follicular: You may notice increased range and fluidity—explore slightly deeper mobility while maintaining control and alignment.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Take advantage of natural flexibility and coordination—move through fuller ranges while staying mindful of joint stability.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Use this session to maintain mobility and prevent tightness—focus on smooth, consistent movement rather than increasing range.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Prioritize gentle, soothing mobility—keep movements slow and controlled to reduce tension and support recovery.
